prior_year_events.impact_description: The announcement to reduce the statutory discount rate to -0.75% and subsequent revision to an assumed +0.25% was reflected in the 2017 result and affected reserves (UK personal injury / Employers' Liability assumptions).

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 were GBP 1,148.563m. The report does not disclose a material aggregate gross prior-year reserve movement for 2017; the claims development table (net basis) shows effectively no net prior-year movement for the older underwriting years, resulting in a net prior-year development of nil. Movements were driven by offsetting factors: adverse large loss experience in Professional Lines was offset by favourable impacts (including the assumed Ogden discount rate revision and improved claims ratios/reinsurance positioning).
raw_causal_phrases: adverse large loss experience in the Professional Lines portfolio
impact of the Ogden table changes, including claims inflation assumptions on UK Employer's Liability reserves
reduced in year reinsurance spend and improved net claims ratio
The 2014 and prior years produced a net loss of GBP 10,679k, following worse than expected claims activity, particularly in Professional Indemnity.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement (gross Insurance liabilities movement) was disclosed. The available claims development table is presented on a NET basis; using that net triangle yields effectively zero net prior-year development for older underwriting years. Accordingly prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to 0.0 based on the net triangle; no gross PYD figure was available. All monetary figures taken from GBP '000 tables and converted to millions.
